information: ## Konkurrencen er aflyst pga. COVID-19 udbruddet. Dette er 2. version af Aarhus Spring! Efter selve konkurrencen er færdig om søndagen er der generalforsamling i vores lokalforening Speedcubing Aarhus, som man er meget velkommen til at deltage i. Udover WCA-discipliner afholder vi også 2 [SEE-discipliner](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2020#14405-see-events): - 3x3x3 Med Fødderne - 3x3x3 Team-Blind. Vi tilbyder billig [overnatning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2020#14284-overnatning-accommodation). ___ ## The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. This is the 2nd edition of Aarhus Spring! After the competition is over on sunday we have our general annual meeting in our local Speedcubing Aarhus association, you are welcome to participate. In addition to the WCA events, we are also holding 2 [SEE events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2020#14405-see-events): - 3x3x3 With Feet - 3x3x3 Team-Blind. We offer cheap [accommodation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusSpring2020#14284-overnatning-accommodation).
